  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Number Theory and Cryptography [IT_3130]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-B  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           a. How many 3-digit non-negative numbers are there that have reminder 7 when divided  
  by 101? Here we assume that 1- digit and 2-digit numbers are also 3-digit, they just start  
  with 0.                                                                                    (5)  
  A)      b. Show that the inverse of 5 modulo 101 is 599.  
  
  B)      Consider an apple which costs 22 dollars. A customer wants to buy one apple but has  
  only 3-dollar coins (in any quantity). The shopkeeper has only 5-dollar coins for giving  
  change. How can the transaction be completed so that both the customer and the           (5)  
  shopkeeper are satisfied? Apply suitable logic and compute all possible solutions.  
  
  2)           a. If p and q are distinct prime numbers, prove that ϕ(p*q)=(p-1)(q-1) and verify your  
  $$result for p=37 and q=71$$  
  (5)  
  b. Solve for the positive integer(s) n such that ϕ (n2) = 1000 ϕ (n).  
  A)  
  B)      a. The first 12 digits of a book's ISBN are 978030640615. Compute & verify the check  
  $$digit using d13= (10-( S mod 10)) mod 10 where S is defined as$$  
  
  
  (5)  
  
  
  b. Determine x for the congruence relation, 5x = 31 (mod 101).  
  
  3)           Compute the following  
  (a) Calculate 132010 (mod 71).  
  (b) Calculate 100-1 (mod 2011).                                                            (5)  
  A)      (c) Calculate phi (2010).  
  
  B)      Let (G, +) be an abelian group. In G we define the product ab = 0 for all a, b 2 G. Show  
  that G is a ring.                                                                        (5)  
  
  4)           Assume that in hill cipher, we know that the plaintext of our ciphertext message that  
  begins WBVE is INMA compute the Key.  
  (5)  
  A)
